name: Asbury Park
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Asbury Park, NJ 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Asbury Park, NJ for 2026: three tree lightings, the Convention Hall Holiday Bazaar and a nearby Santa train.
lede: Asbury Park lights three trees in eight days, fills Convention Hall with a free holiday bazaar and sits a short drive from the Santa Claus Express in Allaire State Park.
celebrates: The City of Asbury Park invites residents and visitors to gather with neighbors for Christmas tree lightings at Firemen's Park and Springwood Park, each with Santa, holiday music and treats. The Asbury Park Chamber of Commerce holds its Annual Downtown Tree Lighting at Press Plaza. The Holiday Bazaar fills the Grand Arcade at Convention Hall on weekends through the middle of December. A few miles inland, the New Jersey Museum of Transportation runs Santa Claus trains in Allaire State Park.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap of Asbury Park's tree lightings on a host page, so this page leans on the host pages for the current season. The city's fall and winter 2026 newsletter shows the lightings and the bazaar scheduled together across early December, and the city also lists an annual Kwanzaa celebration at the Senior Center. The New Jersey Museum of Transportation's Santa Claus Express is a yearly program at the Pine Creek Railroad.
facts: Asbury Park's city site lists each park by its cross streets: Firemen's Park at Main Street and Sunset Avenue and Springwood Park at Springwood and Atkins Avenues. The Chamber's downtown tree lighting is at Press Plaza, at Cookman Avenue and Emory Street. The Pine Creek Railroad is a museum run railroad inside Allaire State Park, and the museum sells its train tickets in person only, at the ticket office, at $7 per person.
trains: The Santa Claus Express at the Pine Creek Railroad, run by the New Jersey Museum of Transportation at 4265 Atlantic Avenue in Wall Township, is the closest Christmas train ride to Asbury Park. Day trains leave every half hour on select days, and night trains run on two December evenings. Our New Jersey guide at /blog/christmas-train-ride-new-jersey lists more rides across the state.
traditions: The city lights the Firemen's Park tree with Santa, music and hot chocolate.
The Springwood Park tree is lit with an appearance by Santa and treats for the kids.
The Chamber of Commerce lights the tree at Press Plaza.
Convention Hall's Grand Arcade hosts the free bazaar on weekends.
Museum trains run on the Pine Creek Railroad in Allaire State Park.

Yes. The New Jersey Museum of Transportation runs the Santa Claus Express at the Pine Creek Railroad in Allaire State Park, with $7 tickets sold in person at the ticket office.
